Maybe, for the short storm chapter, if placing buildings on my phone worked on the first try and I could see my people moving on the map. The people's small confessions and the way they answered my requests are what would bring me back. I would not return to the long settlement day as it is now unless it told me plainly what to aim for and showed progress on the map instead of in repeated text.

I would not leave it running in the background. I might come back another evening, for the short chapter only.
